prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The moon's wooden door turned teal. Target near x83%, y18%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The nearest book’s star became a crescent. Target near x45%, y84%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The cat’s tail has a white tip. Target near x19%, y50%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The crescent on the book under the cat disappeared. Target near x53%, y60%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The tiny star above the drifting smoke disappeared. Target near x56%, y2%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The moon's wooden door turned teal.
The nearest book’s star became a crescent.
The cat’s tail has a white tip.
The crescent on the book under the cat disappeared.
The tiny star above the drifting smoke disappeared.
